flux_meta.kcat_notes: Open Enzyme Database first (1126 organism rows, substrate-matched against 3710 units), then the EC homolog tier (35753 rows, any organism), then predicted tier = median over ezkinetics, eitlem, unikp (verified tables, admitted by own_class_band against the EC-median lookup at 0.532), then the median of the 879 database-tier values, 9.6 1/s. A complex takes the min over its subunits.

compartment_volume_fractions.source: Uchida M, Sun Y, McDermott G, Knoechel C, Le Gros MA, Parkinson D, Yang S, Larabell CA (2011). Quantitative analysis of yeast internal architecture using soft X-ray tomography. Yeast 28(3):227-236, doi 10.1002/yea.1834. Read from the PMC author manuscript PMC3404734 mirrored at $DATA_ROOT/torchcell-raw/uchidaQuantitativeAnalysisYeast2011/paper/pmc_fulltext.xml, sha256 4ad4cee88e942feffffd4c372b8b085f59ea70a303331a8173c9ccf260477aa2.
compartment_volume_fractions.quote: On average, the nucleus occupied 6-11% of cell volume; the nucleolus occupied 20% of nucleus; vacuole(s) occupied 3-14% of cell; and mitochondria and lipid bodies occupied 1-2% of cell ( Figure 3 ); therefore, the cytosol, other non-segmented organelles, large macromolecular complexes, such as the ribosomes, and the cytoskeleton occupy the remaining 70% of cell volume.
compartment_volume_fractions.note: Four of six entries are measured on Saccharomyces cerevisiae by soft X-ray tomography; the endoplasmic reticulum and the peroxisome are not resolved by that study and stay flagged. The entries do not sum to 1 and are not meant to: a compartment where the model carries no species for a metabolite contributes nothing to that metabolite's whole-cell average, and the cytosolic 0.70 already contains volume that is not aqueous cytosol. Per-entry notes: c: The paper's remainder. An UPPER bound on the aqueous cytosol, since the same 70 percent also holds the cytoskeleton, the ribosomes and the organelles the study did not segment.; er: NOT SOURCED. Inside Uchida's unsegmented remainder. Carried as a textbook order of magnitude so the mixture has a weight for it, and flagged so no reading rests on it.; m: Midpoint of 1 to 2 percent, which the paper reports jointly for mitochondria and lipid bodies; the mitochondrial share alone is therefore at most this.; n: Midpoint of 6 to 11 percent.; p: NOT SOURCED. Inside Uchida's unsegmented remainder, and in glucose medium peroxisomes are few and small. Flagged, as for the ER.; v: Midpoint of 3 to 14 percent. The range is wide because vacuolar volume tracks the cell cycle stage and the strain, and the paper reports five vacuole morphologies.

validation_selection_split.note: the split the epoch was SELECTED on, so this is not held out; reported beside the test block because the pinned test genes carry few amino-acid measurements.

definitions.balance_median_ratio: median over the independent rows i of S of |(Sv)_i| / (omega_i + balance_epsilon), with omega_i = 0.5 sum_j |S_ij v_j| the layer's own turnover. This is FluxLayer.forward's feas_balance_median, per sample instead of batch-reduced.
definitions.balance_max_ratio: the same ratio, maximized over the independent rows.
definitions.box_violation_frac: fraction of the 4,131 reactions with v > ub + 1e-4 or v < lb - 1e-4, where (lb, ub) is FluxLayer.dynamic_box at this sample's availability and abundance. The box parameterization satisfies this by construction, so a nonzero value is a bug rather than an infeasibility.
definitions.thermo_model_violation_frac: fraction of active reactions (delta_r_g0_mask and not thermo_exempt) with v * delta_r_G > thermo_epsilon, using the layer's OWN delta_r_G from reaction_potential, which includes the learned concentration term. Available only when the arm's thermo_mode is not OFF.
definitions.thermo_model_uphill_frac: mean over active reactions of relu(v dG + eps) / (|v||dG| + eps), the per-sample form of the layer's c_thermo. Available only when thermo_mode is not OFF.
definitions.thermo_standard_state_violation_frac: fraction of active reactions with v * (delta_r_G0 + delta_r_G_transport) > thermo_epsilon. An AUDIT REFERENCE, not the layer's own term: it evaluates the second law at standard state because an arm with thermo_mode OFF learns no concentrations, so the concentration term RT S^T ln c is absent rather than zero.
definitions.thermo_standard_state_uphill_frac: the same standard-state driving force in the c_thermo normalization.
definitions.fractions: fraction of the genotypes in the group meeting each named criterion. 'both_balance_le_1e-02_and_<thermo>_eq_0' is the Genesis criterion: mass balance within 1 percent and no uphill active reaction.
definitions.rank_by: top-100 groups are the 100 genotypes with the HIGHEST predicted betaxanthin (denormalized head mean), i.e. the strains the model nominates as producers.
